nodes.label: Three-Engine Model (Computation / Retrieval / Generation)
nodes.rationale: Almost none of the system is a trained model; deterministic formulas are auditable and need no labeled data, RAG uses pre-trained embeddings, LLM only phrases. Only disease CV is trained.

nodes.label: Rule: Never let the LLM invent a number that matters
nodes.rationale: A wrong pesticide dose or irrigation call costs a season; numbers must come from retrieved sources or computed context.

nodes.label: P1 Compute first, retrieve second, generate last
P2 No source, no claim
nodes.rationale: If retrieval returns nothing relevant, answer says so rather than falling back to general knowledge.

nodes.label: P3 Personalization is structural, not a prompt trick
Visible 'grounded in' sources/computed trail
nodes.rationale: Turns 'trust me' into 'check me'; strong demo feature.

nodes.label: Advisory confidence (grounded/partial/insufficient)
nodes.rationale: Computed, not asserted by the LLM; mirrors weather layer confidence field.

nodes.label: Cross-link to market trend near harvest
Growth-stage engine (Growing Degree Days)
nodes.rationale: GDD tracks physiological progress better than days-since-sowing; Tmax/Tmin already in weather_daily_fused.

nodes.label: Water-requirement engine (ETc = Kc x ET0)
nodes.rationale: Simple water balance; ignores soil moisture storage — IoT sensor should override.

nodes.label: Climate/temperature suitability engine
nodes.rationale: observed temp and reading_source are generic inputs so IoT can override weather forecast.

nodes.label: Disease detection (MobileNetV2 on PlantVillage)
nodes.rationale: The one real trained model; CV label is a search key into cited text, never the final advisory.

nodes.label: Worked example: Should I water my tomatoes today? (Nashik)
Bhashini multilingual routing (both directions)
nodes.rationale: Gemini multilingual is uneven (Gujarati failures); keep reasoning/retrieval in English and translate via Bhashini (IndicTrans2).

nodes.label: Post-generation number-grounding check
nodes.rationale: Log-only first; over-aggressive blocking makes the assistant useless.

nodes.label: Phone number + OTP login
nodes.rationale: Phone more universal than email among Indian farmers; Supabase supports OTP natively.

nodes.label: Advisory API contract (/api/advisory/ask, disease-check, feedback, schemes)
IMD Gramin Krishi Mausam Sewa (GKMS)
nodes.rationale: Design precedent, not a live source: PDF/SMS only, DAMU network shut down March 2024.

nodes.label: SoilGrids (ISRIC)
nodes.rationale: Last-resort fallback: ML-predicted and REST API has outages.
